agreements: The frozen proposal is a pre-context, fixed-source, one-cycle synthetic construct; it does not test LoRA, compression, lifetime scaling, learned control, context overflow, on-policy evidence acquisition, or self-improving learning rate.

Its strongest retained contribution is the CPU construct layer: exhaustive sparse factor/null certificates, public-prefix h continuations, the fixed-h 2^4 target theorem, target uniqueness, and an exact-program ceiling.
OPAQUE_NOTE_SELF is the only natural primary lane; OPERATOR_AST is an explicitly structure-assisted diagnostic that may neither translate, rescue, nor explain opaque results.

The h fork can identify raw-A-conditioned Dream-2 revision and the corpus interventions can identify later text-to-action effects, provided their byte, seed, and visibility contracts are made executable.

Any eventual S1 result is at most descriptive evidence on the exact registered DEV roots and frozen interface; it is not population inference, benchmark superiority, recurrence efficiency, external-memory superiority, or a paper claim.
Current broad owner directives, advisory agreement, CPU success, or future review do not constitute exact human ratification or authority to implement, run models, use GPUs, or advance intake.

disagreements.issue: Whether the frozen causal and DEV wording is supported by the temporal graph and the one-root-per-family roster.

positions.position: One maximum-positive sentence permits life-specific text to causally improve prospective predictions and actions and describes a positive S1 endpoint.
Predictions precede the frozen corpus, and nested rows are not a population; only raw-A-to-revision, corpus-to-later-action, and root-specific descriptive statements are supportable.

resolution.rationale: The present bytes conflate two temporally distinct interventions and leave wording capable of a paper/benchmark reading despite headline_ineligible claims and no root-level confirmation sample.
resolution.selected_position: Split causal clauses and restrict all DEV reporting to exact registered roots and the frozen interface.
resolution.required_change: Rehash a proposal that states separately: committed prospective predictions; raw A caused branch-appropriate Dream-2 revision only if the fork passes; and frozen corpus interventions changed later actions only if the action cut passes. Prohibit p-values, intervals, rankings, prevalence, efficacy, SOTA, and paper claims pending a separately authorized powered root-level confirmation.

disagreements.issue: Whether a lane whose meaning is deliberately undefined can be semantically audited for truth, falsehood, or solution packets.

positions.position: T09/T11 and the scorer require false-object symmetry, no completed solution packet, and semantic/truth audit across the two-lane system.
Those opaque requirements require exactly the semantic or target-aware interpreter the primary lane excludes.

resolution.rationale: No target-independent mechanical rule recognizes arbitrary prose as semantically false or as an encoded closure without changing the cognitive/visibility boundary.
resolution.selected_position: Opaque checks are limited to bytes, provenance, public-reference closure, target-blind corpus freeze, surface-only retrieval, bounded returns, action interventions, and target-manifest invariance; semantic truth, false-shape, no-solution-packet, and itemwise claims are AST/structured-only.
resolution.required_change: Rewrite T09, T11, visibility/scorer wording, and S1 claims accordingly; add a process audit proving no semantic opaque classifier is present upstream or terminally used to gate/explain an opaque endpoint.

disagreements.issue: Whether catalog, mutation, reset, and seed language freezes all causal inputs and counterfactual coupling.

positions.position: Catalog/read, comparator mutation, sealed role/root seeds, and reset language are sufficient.
Outcome-derived catalog metadata, mutable-field scope, actor dynamics, replay boundary, seed namespaces, and common-random-number pairings remain unstated.

resolution.rationale: The exact bytes do not say which pre-READ fields may differ, which private fields mutate while actor transition bytes remain fixed, or which counterfactual invocations are coupled. A frozen-output replay alone cannot detect a covert dependency; an uncontrolled stochastic rerun cannot promise bit identity.
resolution.selected_position: Use a field-level public-catalog schema, mutable-field registry, static taint/dependency test, declared mechanical replay boundary, and a canonical invocation seed map.
resolution.required_change: Bind IDs/action/time/declared shape only before READ; keep outcome content, hashes, sizes, parse/error/timing metadata behind typed reads. Add a seed map keyed by root/family/z/h-or-q/lane/phase/candidate/arm/cut/target/goal/invocation, state every coupled versus independent draw, bind renderer/reader/actor RNG, and prohibit reallocation.

disagreements.issue: Whether S1 directional/margin/redirection gates and independent-q controls are executable and matched.

positions.position: Failure-inclusive rows and stated S1 direction/margin language suffice.
Numerators, denominators, weighting, ties, failures, q pairing, and reuse of four controls across eight q rows are unspecified.

resolution.rationale: Several reasonable aggregations and control matchings yield different pass/fail results; conditional orbit symmetry does not itself prove finite realized q target blocks interchangeable.
resolution.selected_position: Freeze a row-keyed aggregation program and either run EMPTY/OBSERVED on both q blocks or certify exact q control reuse/equivariance and pairing.
resolution.required_change: Add golden fixtures covering failures, NOT_RUN, ties, h/q, z/antipode, goal twins, targets, first-action versus D4 redirection, and control weights; every assigned failure maps to zero and no result selects a denominator.

disagreements.issue: Whether the specified terminal, reducer, canonicalization, call, and input/output maxima can coexist.

positions.position: T06/T07/T16 can certify prompt/reducer capacity and the aggregate resource envelope.
A 256-token terminal cannot repeat permitted 8KiB candidates/payloads; prompts conflict with reducer REVISE; JSON and live-state budgets are incomplete; CPU and exact-program ledgers are mislabeled.

resolution.rationale: These are literal incompatibilities or missing allocations, not implementation details. A test cannot make the maximum COMMIT object fit a smaller output cap.
resolution.selected_position: Choose and bind a content-addressed staged-object COMMIT design or raise caps and recompute all budgets; reconcile REVISE semantics; version the canonicalizer; distinguish actual/reserved/CPU calls; and prove serialized maxima under each cap.
resolution.required_change: Add maximum legal end-to-end COMMIT, prompt/reducer conformance, adversarial Unicode/JSON, maximum live-state/input, per-Think-output, CPU competing-limit, and actual-versus-reserved exact-program ledger fixtures before re-deliberation.

disagreements.issue: Whether the baseline panel supports preprocessing, recurrence, external-memory, or compilation conclusions.

positions.position: The declared raw/observed/exact/oracle/class/one-shot/A-MEM panel provides a labeled causal localization.
Observed permutations are asymmetrically supplied, opaque one-shot Think is absent, recurrence is compute-unmatched, and A-MEM NOT_RUN cannot support a comparison.

resolution.rationale: The frozen roster cannot establish recurrent Think necessity for opaque SELF or a general external-memory/compilation advantage; the preprocessing treatment is not frozen.
resolution.selected_position: Choose common raw-to-operator preprocessing for all eligible arms or label extraction as part of the learned treatment; restrict recurrence language to eligible-information/output-capacity matched but interaction/compute-unmatched; add opaque one-shot Think or explicitly leave it untested; condition conclusions on faithfully run baselines.
resolution.required_change: Revise T07/T13 and all report text, amend resource/seed rosters if an opaque one-shot cell is added, and prohibit A-MEM/external-memory/persistence/long-context superiority whenever native A-MEM is NOT_RUN.
